title: pilosella × byzantina
intro: Pilosella × byzantina, commonly known as Mouse Ears, is a hybrid plant species in the dandelion family, derived from the cross between Pilosella officinarum and Pilosella eichleriana. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella × byzantina include its ability to stimulate digestion, alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as pilosellin and lactucin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
